info.name: POS & Shop Management System API
info.description:
Complete API collection for Enterprise Cloud-Based POS & Shop Management System.
Includes automated Bearer Token handling, comprehensive CRUD operations, Cashier Shifts, POS Checkout, GRN, and Analytics.

item.name: 01. System & Health
item.description: System health check and diagnostic endpoints

request.description: Check if backend server is online and operational.

item.name: 02. Authentication (Auth)
item.description: User login, logout, terminal locking and profile inspection.

exec: console.log("✅ Token successfully saved to environment: " + res.data.token.substring(0, 20) + "...");

request.description: Logs in as Admin. The Postman test script automatically captures and saves the JWT token into the active environment variable `token`.

exec: console.log("✅ Token successfully saved to environment: " + res.data.token.substring(0, 20) + "...");

request.description: Logs in as Staff Cashier and automatically stores token.
Returns profile details and permissions for the currently authenticated session.
Locks POS screen for security.
Unlocks POS screen with 4-digit PIN.
Invalidates session token and clears auth cookie.

item.name: 03. Users & Staff Management
item.description: CRUD operations for staff, cashiers, and administrators.

request.description: Retrieve all users with roles.
Create a new staff user with designated role.
Fetch specific user details.
Update user profile details.
Update quick terminal unlock 4-digit PIN.
Soft delete / deactivate a staff user.

item.name: 04. Roles & Permissions
item.description: Manage RBAC security roles and system permissions.

request.description: List all existing security roles.
List all permission keys available in the system.
Define a new custom role with granular permissions.
Modify permissions for an existing role.

item.name: 05. Categories & Brands
item.description: Organize product catalog into hierarchical categories and manufacturer brands.

request.description: List all product categories.
Add a new product category.
Update category info.
Remove a category.
List all registered brands.
Create a brand entry.
Update brand info.
Delete brand.

item.name: 06. Products & Catalog
item.description: Manage master items, multi-attribute variants, barcodes, pricing, and stock on hand.

request.description: Fetch paginated products catalog.
Scan or search product by EAN/Code-128 barcode.
Fetch full product details and all variants.

item.name: 07. Customers & CRM
item.description: Customer profiles, credit limits, loyalty points, and receivables ledgers.

request.description: List all customer accounts.
Register a new retail or trade customer.
View customer balance and profile.
Update credit limit or contact info.
Audit statement of all sales, payments, and running balance.
Record customer due collection and automatically update ledger & till.
Deactivate customer account.

item.name: 08. Suppliers & Vendors
item.description: Vendor master data, procurement balance, and payment disbursals.

request.description: Retrieve all registered suppliers.

request.description: Create new vendor account.
Get supplier profile and payable balance.
Update vendor profile.
Audit log of GRN receipts, payments, and outstanding balances.
Pay vendor from bank/cash account.
Delete or deactivate supplier.

item.name: 09. Procurement (PO & GRN)
item.description: Purchase orders, status workflows, and Goods Received Note (GRN) processing.

request.description: List all purchase orders.
Generate a new PO in DRAFT status.
Fetch PO details.
Change PO workflow status.
Record physical inventory arrival, update stocks, batches, and supplier balance.

item.name: 10. Cashier Shifts & Till
item.description: Cash drawer shifts, float tracking, petty cash, and daily Z-Reports.

request.description: Check if current cashier has an open till session.
Open a new till with initial opening cash.
List shift sessions history.
Record petty cash withdrawal or injection from the drawer.
End shift, record physical cash count and calculate discrepancy.
Get comprehensive financial Z-Report for audit and print.

item.name: 11. Point of Sale (POS) & Billing
item.description: Checkout, multi-payment tenders, split bills, cart hold/resume, and thermal printing.

request.description: Complete sale invoice, deduct inventory stock via FEFO/FIFO, and record payment.
List parked or held customer carts.
Temporarily park a cart without completing sale.
Load parked cart back to terminal.
Delete an abandoned held cart.
Fetch sale transaction details by invoice number.
Formatted receipt output for 80mm or 58mm thermal printers.

item.name: 12. Sales Returns & Vouchers
item.description: Item return handling, restocking conditions, and store credit voucher issuance.

request.description: List all processed return transactions.
Process return, optionally restock item, and generate credit voucher.
Fetch return record details.
Validate voucher code and remaining balance during checkout.

item.name: 13. Accounts & Banking
item.description: Cash, Bank, and Mobile Money (bKash/Nagad) accounts & inter-account transfers.

request.description: List all financial cash, bank, and MFS accounts.
Add a new bank or wallet account.
Get account balance and details.
View full debit/credit history of this account.
Transfer money from one account to another.

item.name: 14. Expense Management
item.description: Store operating expenses, utility bills, maintenance, and expense categories.

request.description: List all expense heads/categories.
Create a new expense category.
Retrieve logged expenses.
Log an operating expense paid from an account.

item.name: 15. Inventory Adjustments & Wastage
item.description: Track spoiled, broken, or expired merchandise and record stock write-offs.

request.description: List all recorded inventory loss and write-offs.
Write off damaged stock and record loss accounting entry.

item.name: 16. Reports & Analytics
item.description: Executive KPIs, daily sales, P&L, stock valuation, and export utilities.

request.description: High-level store performance, today revenue, orders count, low stock warnings.
Sales breakdown by date and channel.
Best-selling products, quantities sold, and gross margins.
Total stock asset valuation at cost vs retail price, reorder alerts.
Revenue, COGS, Gross Profit, Expenses, and Net Profit.
List of customers with overdue credit balances.
Upcoming supplier liabilities and procurement dues.
Download CSV file of sales records.
Generate PDF sales report.
Generate formatted XLSX sales workbook.

item.name: 17. Audit Logs
item.description: System audit trails, activity logging, and security inspection.

request.description: View chronological audit log of user actions and sensitive events.

item.name: 18. Store Settings
item.description: Store business identity, tax rates, receipt headers, and localization.

request.description: Retrieve current store profile and config.
